metadata.notes: Vue 3 SPA using vue-router with glob-based auto-discovery of all views under src/views/**/*.vue. No authentication. No external API calls. Animation demo playground for the motion-v library.

nodes.label: Home — grid of all route links
actions: Navigate to any demo route via router-link grid card
nodes.notes: Renders all non-root routes as clickable cards via router.getRoutes()

nodes.label: Home.vue — empty page
nodes.notes: Home.vue is empty; renders blank content within router-view

nodes.label: 404 — Page Not Found
actions: Click 'Go Home' link [router-link to='/']
nodes.notes: Displays 404 message; matched by [..404].vue and wildcard route

nodes.label: AnimatePresence Demo — item hidden
actions: Click 'Show' button [id=toggle] to reveal animated item
nodes.notes: Default state: animated item not yet shown

nodes.label: AnimatePresence Demo — item visible
actions: Click 'Hide' button [id=toggle] to exit-animate item
Click 'Remove' button inside card [class=text-red-500]
nodes.notes: Animated card visible; motion.div with exit animation on hide

nodes.label: Group AnimatePresence — panel closed
actions: Click 'Toggle open' button to open panel
nodes.notes: LayoutGroup with AnimatePresence; container collapses when closed

nodes.label: Group AnimatePresence — panel open
actions: Click 'Toggle open' button to close panel
nodes.notes: Text content revealed; layout-animated container expands

nodes.label: Multiple Motion Components — items shown
actions: Click toggle button [id=toggle] to hide all motion items
nodes.notes: Two motion.div items; tracks exitComplete via span [id=exit-status]

nodes.label: Multiple Motion Components — items hidden, exit complete
actions: Click toggle button [id=toggle] to show items
nodes.notes: onExitComplete fires; span [id=exit-status] shows 'exited'

nodes.label: Nested Motion — items visible
actions: Click 'Hide' button [id=toggle] to exit-animate all nested items
nodes.notes: Parent + two children all animate independently with staggered entries

nodes.label: Nested Motion — items hidden
actions: Click 'Show' button [id=toggle] to animate items in
nodes.notes: All nested motion components unmounted after exit animation

nodes.label: v-show Shared Layout — large box shown
actions: Click 'Show Large' / 'Show Small' button [id=toggle] to toggle box size
nodes.notes: Tests v-show with shared layout animation; tracks animationStarted/Completed

nodes.label: AnimatePresence Variants — list visible
actions: Click 'Hide' button to exit-animate list items via variants
nodes.notes: motion.ul with listVariants; items stagger with delay on open/close

nodes.label: AnimatePresence Variants — list hidden
actions: Click 'Show' button to animate list in with staggered variants
nodes.notes: List unmounted; variant propagation from parent to children tested

nodes.label: v-motion Directive — showcase
actions: Observe entry animations on page load (v-motion props-extraction and binding-value boxes)
Toggle visibility via reactive ref (isVisible) — button label 'Hide'/'Show'
nodes.notes: Three directive syntax demos: props-extraction, binding-value, event callbacks

nodes.label: Preset Directives — v-fade-in, v-slide-up, v-scale-in
actions: Toggle visibility of preset-animated box [button in section]
nodes.notes: Globally registered preset directives: v-fade-in, v-slide-up, v-scale-in

nodes.label: Drag Animations — draggable box in container
actions: Drag box within constraint container [Motion component with drag prop]
nodes.notes: Box scale animates 1.1 on dragStart, back to 1 on dragEnd

nodes.label: Drag Animations — box being dragged (scale 1.1)
actions: Release drag to end drag interaction
nodes.notes: Box visually scales up during drag via :animate={scale}

nodes.label: Drag Constraints Animation — multiple drag tests
actions: Drag green box with dragSnapToOrigin [Test 2 container]
Observe drag-start/drag-end counters increment
nodes.notes: Multiple test scenarios: dragSnapToOrigin in Test 2; counters track events

nodes.label: Scroll While Drag Test
actions: Drag red box inside scrollable container
Scroll container while dragging
nodes.notes: Tests that box stays attached to cursor while scrolling during drag

nodes.label: dragSnapToOrigin Test
actions: Drag box anywhere and release — snaps back to origin
Click during snap-back to test interrupt behavior
nodes.notes: Tracks dragCount and snapBackCount via ref counters

nodes.label: Dynamic Variant — visible state
actions: Click 'Toggle' button [data-testid=toggle-btn]
Observe motion.button animate to 'visible' or 'hidden' variant
nodes.notes: whileInView alternates between 'visible' (opacity 1) and 'hidden' (opacity 0.25)

nodes.label: Dynamic Variant — hidden/dimmed state
actions: Click 'Toggle' button [data-testid=toggle-btn] to restore visible state
nodes.notes: motion.button [data-testid=motion-btn] dims to opacity 0.25 in hidden variant

nodes.label: Gesture Animations — hover/tap demo
actions: Hover over animated box — scale 1.2, rotate 5deg, borderRadius 16px
Tap/click animated box — scale briefly 0.8 then back to 1
nodes.notes: onHoverStart/End and onTap handlers mutate scale/rotate/borderRadius refs

nodes.label: Gesture Hover — navigation menu closed
actions: Click hamburger toggle button [class=toggle-container] to open nav
nodes.notes: motion.nav animated sidebar with hamburger toggle; 5 color-coded list items

nodes.label: Gesture Hover — navigation menu open
actions: Click close toggle button [class=toggle-container] to close nav
Hover over list items — scale 1.1
Press list items — scale 0.95
nodes.notes: Nav open; 5 list items stagger in; hamburger morphs to X via SVG path variants

nodes.label: Layout Mount — container hidden
actions: Click 'Toggle' button [id=toggle] to show layout container
nodes.notes: Tests layout element mounting inside scaling container

nodes.label: Layout Mount — container visible with layout child
actions: Click 'Toggle' button [id=toggle] to hide container with exit animation
nodes.notes: Inner motion.div [id=layout-child] should NOT perform layout animation on mount

nodes.label: Pop Layout — list with items (wait mode)
actions: Click 'Add item' button [Motion as=button] to append animated item
Click any item card to remove it with exit animation
Check 'popLayout' checkbox to switch animation mode
nodes.notes: AnimatePresence mode='wait' by default; items in pink rounded cards

nodes.label: Pop Layout — list with items (popLayout mode)
actions: Click any item card to remove with popLayout exit animation
Click 'Add item' button to append item
Uncheck 'popLayout' checkbox to restore wait mode
nodes.notes: AnimatePresence mode='popLayout'; remaining items animate position with layout

nodes.label: Reorder Auto-Scroll — vertical and horizontal lists
actions: Drag vertical item [data-testid=<item-number>] to reorder
Drag vertical item to top/bottom edge to trigger auto-scroll
Drag horizontal item [data-testid=h-<item>] to reorder
Drag horizontal item to left/right edge to trigger auto-scroll
nodes.notes: Two lists: vertical (16 items, 300px container) and horizontal (15 items)

nodes.label: Horizontal Scroll — useScroll with x axis
actions: Scroll horizontally inside container [class=scroll-container-h]
nodes.notes: Displays scrollX and scrollXProgress MotionValues via RowValue component

nodes.label: Scroll Presets — ScrollOffset.Enter preset
actions: Scroll vertically inside container to move target in/out of view
nodes.notes: useScroll with offset=ScrollOffset.Enter; shows scrollYProgress in RowValue

nodes.label: Scroll Reactive — y axis
actions: Scroll inside container [class=scroll-container]
Click 'Toggle axis' button [class=toggle-axis] to switch to x axis
nodes.notes: Tracks scrollX/Y and progress; axis is reactive; container is 300x300px

nodes.label: Scroll Reactive — x axis
actions: Scroll horizontally inside container
Click 'Toggle axis' button [class=toggle-axis] to switch back to y axis
nodes.notes: Current axis shown in span [class=current-axis]; useScroll recreated reactively

nodes.label: Scroll Test — useScroll with Motion container and target
actions: Scroll vertically inside Motion container [class=scroll-container]
nodes.notes: Motion used as scroll container ref; target is nested Motion; shows Y and progress

nodes.label: Test — Mount/Unmount with v-motion directive
actions: Click 'Hide'/'Show' button to toggle AnimatePresence item
nodes.notes: v-motion directive with layoutId on nested Motion; tests spring transition

nodes.label: Test — item unmounted after exit animation
actions: Click 'Show' button to mount and animate item in
nodes.notes: Exit: opacity 0, scale 0.5, rotate 10 spring animation

nodes.label: Transition Arc — arc path animation demos
actions: Click 'Toggle' [data-testid=ping-btn] to ping-pong arc animation
Click rotate 'Toggle' [data-testid=rotate-btn] to arc with rotation
Click 'Next' [data-testid=axis-btn] to step through axis-change targets
Click layout arc button [data-testid=layout-btn] to swap shared element
nodes.notes: Four arc sections: ping-pong, keyframe+rotate, axis-continuity, layout-arc

nodes.label: Transition Arc — ping-pong box at target position
actions: Click 'Toggle' [data-testid=ping-btn] to arc back to origin
nodes.notes: Box at {x:260, y:120}; arc() path maintains stable screen-side

nodes.label: Transition Arc — layout element swapped to right
actions: Click layout arc button [data-testid=layout-btn] to swap back to left
nodes.notes: Shared-element layout animation travels arc path; rotate:true orients to path

nodes.label: v-show Shared Layout — tracking animation lifecycle
actions: Click toggle to switch box size; observe animationStarted/animationCompleted states
nodes.notes: Emits onAnimationStart and onAnimationComplete; states shown in DOM

edges.trigger: pointer-down on Motion draggable box [drag prop]

auth_zones.label: No authentication required — all routes public

layouts.label: Root router-view wrapped in global Motion transition
